content:
Want to get started on your adventure towards ghoulification or have a wastelander that could use a boost?

Whether you're new to Fallout 76 or a long-time resident of Appalachia looking to get a character battle-ready, the Level 50 Character Boost is right for you. Get the level 50 character boost with Atoms and bring any of your wastelanders to level 50.

With the **Level 50 Character Boost** you'll be ready to get started in Fallout 76 and immediately take part in multiplayer activities such as daily operations, public events and some story content.

The Level 50 Character Boost includes:

- A one-time character-specific boost to level 50
- 1,000 bottle caps
- A set of unlocked map markers for fast travel
- A set of starting armor and weapons with some modifications
- Skill cards and a full S.P.E.C.I.A.L. loadout
- Premium consumables and chems
- A variety of blueprints and recipes for crafting

You can purchase the Level 50 Character Boost from the **Atomic Shop** at any time before your character reaches level 50. When you first leave Vault 76 with a new character, you will have the option to open the Atomic Shop and purchase a level 50 character boost. To do this you must be connected to the server.

**Cost: 1,500 Atoms**

## All details

### Unlocked map markers

- Atlas
-Foundation
-Craters
- The White Spring
- Vault 76
- The Wayward
- The Rusty Pick
- Overseer's home
- Emmett Mountain Landfill
- Cave on the slope
- Train stations in Appalachia

### Equipment and ammunition

**Note:** Characters who have already left Vault 76 can equip the Level 50 Character Boost S.P.E.C.I.A.L. loadout after purchasing it. However, you also have the option of continuing to use your character's current loadout and still receiving the loadout from the level 50 character boost. Equipping the Boost loadout will change your current equipment and skills, as well as gaining everything from the list below. Consumables, chems, and blueprints will be placed in your inventory.

**Heavyweight Homecrafted Rifle - 1-Star (Level 45)

- Focused automatic shutter
- Extended run
- Stabilized piston
- Fast magazine
- Reflex sight (dot)

**Oppressor's Super Hammer** - 1-star

- Heating coil

**Weightless Battle Armor** - 1-Star (Level 50)

- Polymer
- Deep pockets
- Padded left and right leg armor

**Chemical protective suit**

**Gas mask**

**Vault 76 Suit**

### Equipped skill card loadout

- **11 Strength:** Bat (3), Martial Artist (3), First Aid Kit (2), Weapon Belt (2)
- **7 Perception:** Commando (3), Concentrated Fire (3), Lockpicking (1)
- **6 Stamina:** Life Giver (2), Adamantium Skeleton (1), Slash and Stab Resistant (3)
- **5 Charisma:** Lone Wanderer (2), Inspirational (1), Oppressor (2)
- **10 Intelligence:** Recycler (1), Hacker (1), First Aid (1), Frugal Tinkerer (2), Nerd Rage (3), Pharmacist (1), Demolition Expert (1)
- **11 Agility:** Marathon Runner (2), Adrenaline (4), Born Survivor (2), Action Boy/Girl (3)
- **6 Luck:** Serendipity (1), Bloody Death (3), Curator (1), Repair Shot (1)

### Other skill cards owned

- **Strength:** Large and Heavy (3), Iron Fist (3), Gladiator (3)
- **Perception:** Rifleman (3), Archer (3)
- **Stamina:** Rejuvenated (2)
- **Charisma:** Team Medic (3)
- **Intelligence:** Demolition Expert (3)
- **Agility:** Guerrilla (3), Gunslinger (3)
